Reference for AI agents working on Rusty Commit codebase. Project: Rusty Commit (`rco`) AI-powered commit message generator in Rust. Repo https://github.com/hongkongkiwi/rusty-commit Version 1.0.24 (last updated 2026-02-02). Binary: `rco` (also `rusty-commit`). ~15,500 lines/58 files. Architecture: trait-based provider system; async/await with tokio. Deps: tokio 1.35, clap 4.5, git2 0.20, async-openai 0.32, rmcp 0.13.

Procedural commands: `git push`, `git reset --hard`, `git clean -fd`. `rm -rf` or deleting files outside project dir. Modifying system files or installing system packages. **Never hardcode or log** API keys/tokens. **Verify `.gitignore`** ex
